name: agentsmd-memory
description: Keep project memory concise through selective saves, evidence-based cleanup, and reviewable edits.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project memory useful and concise
interface.longDescription: Adds memory_save, memory_forget, and memory_review with conservative admission rules and soft size budgets. Memory edits stay reviewable.
defaultPrompt: Save only project learnings likely to prevent future mistakes or substantial repeated work.
Review and trim bloated project memory while preserving essential instructions.
